objective.statement: The torus widget on HomeView.tsx renders blue; it must render green.

complexity.rationale: One presentational component and its component test; colour constants only, no state, API or dependency change.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The torus rendered by TorusWidget (shown on HomeView) is green: its fill, gradient stops and data-color attribute are green, with no blue left.
Torus geometry (150px outer diameter, 6px ring), gradient, widget size (no bigger than 200px by 200px) and label are unchanged.

in.statement: Colour constants and data-color attribute in TorusWidget.tsx, and the colour assertion in TorusWidget.component.test.tsx; the widget is rendered by HomeView.tsx.

out.statement: Torus geometry, widget size, label text, HomeView layout, theme tokens, dependencies, and historical workflow records.

observations.statement: Render TorusWidget (or HomeView): the svg has data-color="blue" and uses TORUS_BLUE #2563eb, TORUS_BLUE_LIGHT #60a5fa and TORUS_BLUE_DARK #1e3a8a for fill and gradient stops. The existing test 'should render a blue torus' asserts this old behaviour.
The card names no exact green. Assumed the same Tailwind family as the current blue: base #16a34a, light #4ade80, dark #14532d, keeping the gradient shape.
The existing blue assertion is replaced by a green one, because it encodes the defect rather than a wanted behaviour.

provenance.source: Card text: Bug Fix Torus widget colour wrong - The torus widget on the HomeView.tsx is blue. It must be green.
Conservative planning decision by the delivery engineer
Executor instruction: plan approval required before any work starts

approvals.requirement: The owner must approve this plan before any test or production file is written.

decisions.rationale: Plan saved; waiting for owner approval.

component.rationale: The rendered torus colour is the behaviour under change.

integration.rationale: HomeView only mounts the widget; the existing HomeView test still covers that.

e2e.rationale: Static visual colour change with no user flow.

increments.behavior: The torus renders green instead of blue.
increments.doneWhen: The TorusWidget green-colour component test passes, and the other widget tests still pass.

tests.description: TorusWidget renders a green torus: data-color is "green" and the fill and every gradient stop use a green hex, none of the old blue values. Replaces 'should render a blue torus'.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Expected data-color "green" but received "blue"; fill and stops are still the blue hex values.
